welcome.title:
Point. Scan.
Fix what's broken.
welcome.subtitle: Photograph any hardware component. FixCan identifies it, spots visible damage, and walks you through the repair.
welcome.terms: Demo build. Scans are stored on this device.
welcome.feature1Body: Brand, model and specs from one photo.
welcome.feature2Body: Visible damage flagged with a severity score.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every component you've scanned, in one place.
history.searchPlaceholder: Search by component, brand or model
history.emptyBody: Point your camera at a GPU, battery, board or any component to get started.
history.noResultsBody: Try a different component, brand or model.

detail.noDamageBody: The component looks physically intact in this photo. Keep it clean and monitor temperatures.
detail.deleteBody: This removes the photo and analysis from this device.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted from this device.
detail.disclaimer: Visual inspection only. Not a substitute for professional diagnosis.

camera.title: Scan component
camera.hint: Center the component. Avoid glare and shadows.
camera.permissionBody: FixCan uses the camera to identify components and spot visible damage. You can also import a photo.
camera.readyBody: Make sure the label and any damage are in focus.
camera.errorBody: Something went wrong while analyzing the photo. Please try again.
camera.galleryError: Could not open your photo library.
camera.permissionSettings: Enable camera access in system settings.
camera.noCamera: Camera preview is not available on this device.
camera.tip: Tip: good light and a steady hand improve accuracy.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Technical help for your scans
assistant.noScanBody: Scan a component first, then ask anything about it.
assistant.greeting: I'm looking at your {{name}}. Ask me about the diagnosis, tools, safety or whether it's worth repairing.
assistant.greetingNoScan: Scan a component and I can answer questions about its diagnosis and repair.
assistant.disclaimer: AI guidance can be wrong. Verify before repairing.
assistant.replyWorthYes: Yes — this looks repairable. The damage is {{severity}}, the repair is {{difficulty}}, and it should take {{time}}. Expect around {{cost}} in parts. Start here: {{firstStep}}
assistant.replyWorthPartial: Partially. The damage is {{severity}} and the repair is {{difficulty}}. Some of it is DIY, but I'd get a professional involved for: {{pro}}. Estimated cost: {{cost}}.
assistant.replyWorthNo: I wouldn't attempt this repair. The damage is {{severity}} and the risk of making it worse is high. {{pro}}
assistant.replyWorthNotNeeded: No repair needed — the component looks healthy. Keep it clean and monitor temperatures. If you notice crashes or throttling, run a diagnostic.
assistant.replyCost: The most likely replacement is the {{category}} itself. Look for a {{brand}} {{model}} or a compatible OEM part. Estimated cost: {{cost}}.
assistant.replyDefault: Here's what I see: {{summary}} Severity is {{severity}} and repairability is {{repairability}}. Ask me about tools, safety, cost or next steps.
assistant.replyNoScan: I need a scan first. Head to the Scan tab and photograph the component.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: The app and AI replies will use this language.
profile.deleteHistoryBody: Every photo and analysis will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
profile.privacyBody: Photos stay on this device unless you enable live AI analysis. Demo mode never uploads images.
profile.signOutBody: Your local scans will stay on this device.
